base.role: a Reader computing S × k from a scheme record (the Section 13.3 pin, the Section 14 bound)

every_other_rule_holds: Image level is impossible: from a sidecar header S × k < 2^48, and from a bootstrap any S with S × k ≥ 2^64 breaks the Section 6.6 bound S × (k + m) ≤ 2^32 − 1 in the same bytes.
